description: Data for removal kinetics and breakthrough curves of stormwater vehicle-related mobile organic contaminants in geomedia-amended sand columns [Dataset] is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors María Alejandra Cruz, Jiaqi Xu (Department of Geosciences, Institute of Environmental Assessment and Water Research (IDAEA), Severo Ochoa Exce). This dataset describes the transport and removal of stormwater vehicle-related mobile organic contaminants in geomedia-amended sand columns. The experiments aimed at providing sustainable treatment options for relevant persistent, mobile and toxic (i.e., PMT substances) linked to vehicular traffic pollution. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
